title: torilis scabra
intro: Torilis scabra, commonly known as Rough Hawk's Beard, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Torilis scabra are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are thought to include essential oils, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, although further research is needed to confirm their composition.
